name: HorizontalLineFormat
remarks: Use the HorizontalLineFormat property to return a HorizontalLineFormat object. This example sets the alignment for a new horizontal line. This example adds a horizontal line without any 3D shading. This example adds a horizontal line and sets its length to 50% of the window width.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified HorizontalLineFormat object.

properties.name: PercentWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the specified horizontal line expressed as a percentage of the window width. Read/write Single.

properties.name: NoShade
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word draws the specified horizontal line without 3D shading. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdHorizontalLineAlignment constant that represents the alignment for the specified horizontal line. Read/write.

properties.name: WidthType
properties.description: Returns or sets the width type for the specified HorizontalLineFormat object. Read/write WdHorizontalLineWidthType.
